key_insight: Neuron-OPSD uses internal neuron activations to choose better self-distillation data and build a stronger teacher, improving annotation-free LLM training without ground-truth labels.
engineering_relevance: It offers a practical post-training recipe for specialized-domain LLMs when expert annotation, online feedback, or reward labeling is too expensive or unavailable.
method: Select training examples using neuron-activation signals instead of only output confidence.
Construct teacher context with neuron-aware data to improve pseudo-label quality.
Train the student with on-policy distillation from the teacher distribution, fully annotation-free.
evidence_signal: On specialized-domain benchmarks, the method improves in-domain performance while preserving cross-domain generalization and reducing calibration collapse relative to prior annotation-free baselines.
watch_item: Neuron-based selection and context construction add implementation complexity and may be sensitive to how activation signals are extracted, normalized, and matched to tasks.
paper_title: Neuron-Aware Data Selection for Annotation-Free LLM Self-Distillation
